title: Yellowed Crisp Norwegian Ham Hash
description: A pungent and crisp Norwegian dish featuring ham, perfect for a post-workout meal, with ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly ingredients to promote rest and relaxation.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
Peel and dice the potatoes and carrots, and slice the onions.
In a large bowl, toss the diced potatoes, carrots, and onions with olive oil, salt, black pepper, and paprika until they are evenly coated.
Spread the vegetable mixture on a baking sheet and roast in the oven for 20 minutes.
Meanwhile, dice the Norwegian ham into small pieces and set aside.
In a large skillet, heat a tablespoon of olive oil over medium heat and add the diced ham, cooking until crispy and golden brown.
Add the roasted vegetables to the skillet with the ham and stir to combine.
Make two wells in the hash mixture and crack an egg into each well.
Cook the eggs until the whites are set and the yolks are cooked to desired doneness.
Serve the Yellowed Crisp Norwegian Ham Hash hot, garnished with chopped fresh parsley if desired.
